title: Build Askin student Q&A platform with doubt posting, answers, ratings, and leaderboard

requirements.text: Implement user authentication system with two user roles: Junior (students who post doubts) and Senior (students who answer doubts). Users must be able to sign up and log in using Internet Identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can sign up and specify their role (Junior or Senior)
Users can log in using Internet Identity
User role is persisted and retrieved on login
Authentication state is maintained across sessions

requirements.text: Create doubt posting functionality where Juniors can post doubts with a text description and optionally attach a photo. Each doubt should be stored with the author's identity, timestamp, and attachment.
acceptanceCriteria: Junior users can create a new doubt post with a title and description
Juniors can optionally upload a single photo with their doubt
Each doubt shows the author, timestamp, and attached photo if present
All doubts are displayed in a feed or list view

requirements.text: Build an answer/comment section where Seniors can respond to doubts with explanations. Answers should support text content and optionally allow attaching notes (text files) or short video explanations.
acceptanceCriteria: Senior users can post answers to any doubt
Answers support text explanations
Seniors can optionally attach text notes to their answers
Seniors can optionally attach short video files to their answers
All answers for a doubt are displayed beneath the doubt in chronological order

requirements.text: Implement a rating system where students can rate answers provided by Seniors. Each answer should display its average rating and students should be able to submit a rating from 1 to 5 stars.
acceptanceCriteria: Each answer has a visible rating display (e.g., star icons)
Users can rate an answer from 1 to 5 stars
Average rating is calculated and displayed for each answer
A user can only rate an answer once

requirements.text: Create a points system where Seniors earn points for providing answers and receiving high ratings. Track cumulative points for each Senior user.
acceptanceCriteria: Seniors earn points when they post an answer
Bonus points are awarded for highly rated answers (e.g., 4+ stars)
Each Senior's total points are tracked and persisted
Points are displayed on the Senior's profile or in the leaderboard

requirements.text: Build a leaderboard page that displays the top Seniors ranked by their earned points. The leaderboard should show rank, name, and total points.
acceptanceCriteria: Leaderboard displays Seniors sorted by total points in descending order
Each leaderboard entry shows rank number, Senior name, and points
Leaderboard is accessible from the main navigation
Leaderboard updates dynamically as points change

requirements.text: Design a visually engaging and modern frontend with a cohesive educational theme. Use a warm, friendly color palette (avoid blue and purple unless naturally suited) with clear typography optimized for readability. The layout should emphasize content hierarchy with prominent doubt cards, clean answer threads, and intuitive navigation for juniors and seniors.
acceptanceCriteria: The application has a consistent visual theme across all pages
Color palette and typography are chosen to support an educational, welcoming environment
Layout clearly separates doubts, answers, ratings, and leaderboard sections
UI components follow a cohesive design system

requirements.text: Render generated images for the homepage hero section, doubt placeholder icons, and leaderboard trophy graphics as static assets in frontend/public/assets/generated.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images are stored in frontend/public/assets/generated
Images are correctly referenced in frontend components
All generated images load without errors

constraints: Use React with TypeScript for the frontend
Use Motoko for the backend with single-actor architecture
Use Internet Identity for authentication (not Firebase or other third-party auth)
Store all data in the backend actor's stable storage
Do not integrate external databases or cloud storage services
Video and image uploads must be handled through the backend actor
Do not use Firebase, Flutter, or any technologies outside the platform's stack
nonGoals: AI chatbot integration (mentioned as future scope only)
Mobile app development (Flutter is not supported)
Certificate generation system (mentioned but not detailed)

required: Hero section illustration showing students collaborating and learning together, warm and welcoming educational theme (hero-students.dim_1200x600.png)
Icon representing a question or doubt, simple and friendly style (doubt-icon.dim_128x128.png)
Trophy or medal icon for leaderboard, gold color with celebratory feel (trophy-icon.dim_128x128.png)
Icon for notes or documents, minimalist educational style (notes-icon.dim_64x64.png)
Icon for video content, play button with modern styling (video-icon.dim_64x64.png)
